test_data.lead: Squilla's architecture is borrowed from operating systems: the kernel does the minimum required to be a CMS, and everything else is a sovereign extension. Disable an extension and there is no dead code in core. Add a new extension and it brings its own database tables, HTTP routes, admin UI pages, scripts, and migrations.
test_data.rule: If disabling an extension would leave dead code in core, that code belongs in the extension, not the core.
